claims.exact_behavior: Desktop-bound monitor automatically identifies pending headers blocking fresh daemon jobs and opens one real question at a time using the exact reference context/header/value/reason text. Requests sharing the same pending header share the decision. Yes/No atomically approves/denies the unchanged header; changed/removed headers and stale window callbacks cannot transfer approval to another payload. Later/close keeps pending state, suppressing only that exact question/job set until something changes. An existing-engine widget regression resumes its request with the approved header and omits the denied one.
limitations: Uses a separate native question window rather than the reference JobStatus popup.
Automatic triggering depends on fresh daemon snapshots; requests resume on their next approval check, up to five seconds.
Later/close suppression is native behavior; the reference popup process has no explicit Later action.

counting: One newly implemented existing concrete workflow leaf; header parent/container remains unclaimed.
